# Sonar — Multichain Market Data & Gas Oracle

> Real-time token price, liquidity, volume, FDV, holder concentration, and current gas price
> across Base, Solana, Arbitrum, and BNB Chain — in one fast, timestamped call.
> Built for the loop every AI agent runs before it acts: check price, check gas, check liquidity.
> Reliable by design: redundant public-RPC fallback (public Base/Arbitrum RPCs frequently return
> 403 — Sonar races a pool so you always get an answer). Every response carries freshness_seconds.

## Why Sonar over a raw API
- Multichain in one call (Base, Solana, Arbitrum, BNB) vs single-chain wrappers.
- Reliability is the product: RPC pool + fallback + freshness stamps, not a lone endpoint that 403s.
- Personalized via ACP Accounts (watchlists) and ACP Notification Memos (price/gas alerts).
- Free read-only resource so you can try before you pay.

## Offerings
- token_snapshot — $0.02 — Price, liquidity, 24h volume, FDV, market cap, pair age for any token
  on Base/Solana/Arbitrum/BNB. Chain auto-detected. Input: { address, chain? }.
- gas_now — $0.01 — Current gas across Base/Ethereum/Arbitrum/BNB (gwei) and Solana (base+priority)
  in one call, with RPC fallback. Input: { chain? } (omit for all chains).
- token_holders — $0.02 — Holder count and top-holder concentration (whale risk). Input: { address, chain }.
- market_pulse — $0.03 — Composite: token price+liquidity+volume + gas + chain TVL. The default call.
  Input: { address, chain? }.
- watchlist_set — $0.02 — Store tracked tokens + alert thresholds (ACP Accounts). Input: { items:[{address,chain}], alerts? }.
- watchlist_status — $0.01 — Your watched tokens with change since added. Input: {}.

## Free resource (no payment)
- GET /resource/pulse — current Base gas (gwei) + ETH/SOL/BNB prices.

## Keywords
token price, liquidity check, current gas price Base Solana Arbitrum BNB, multichain market data,
pre-trade check, before you trade, holder concentration, whale check, market data oracle, FDV,
pair age, token snapshot, gas oracle, price feed for agents.

## Endpoints
- Health: /health
- Agent card: /.well-known/agent-card.json
- Data is informational and sourced from public providers (DexScreener, CoinGecko, DeFiLlama, public RPCs, Blockscout).
